# Hush binding generator

# We must run hush-export.exe agains ./bindings.cpp with the -p flag that points to the compile_commands.json file generated by CMake.
# This will generate two files: HushBindings.h and HushBindings.cpp.

add_custom_target(
        GenerateHushBindings
        COMMAND ${HUSH_EXPORT_BIN} -p ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/compile_commands.json ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bindings.cpp
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        COMMENT "Generating Hush bindings..."
)

hush_add_library(TARGET_NAME HushBindings
        LIB_TYPE OBJECT
        SRCS bindings.cpp
)

# HushBindings depends on the GenerateHushBindings target to ensure that the bindings are generated before compiling the library

add_dependencies(HushBindings GenerateHushBindings)

add_library(Hush::Bindings ALIAS HushBindings)

target_link_libraries(HushBindings PUBLIC
        Hush::Threading
        Hush::Engine
        Hush::Input
        Hush::Core
)
